text:
Items in the first photo: a lasagna slice (about 250 g), roasted potatoes (3 small, about 90 g), a Drumstick ice cream cone (about 100 g), and water.

After eating: the plate is clean, so the lasagna and potatoes were eaten. The cone wrapper is open and the ice cream lid is visible, so the ice cream was eaten. The water glass looks about the same, so I count no food energy from it.

Energy estimates:
- Lasagna, 250 g at about 150 kcal/100 g: about 375 kcal.
- Potatoes, 90 g at about 85 kcal/100 g: about 77 kcal, plus some oil, so roughly 90 kcal.
- Drumstick ice cream, about 120 g at roughly 200 kcal per cone (a typical Drumstick is 150–200 kcal; this is the Swedish/Finnish size, around 130 ml, about 175 kcal).

Total: 375 + 90 + 175 = 640 kcal.

Mass: 250 + 90 + 90 (ice cream, about 90 g with the cone) = about 430 g.

{"kcal": 640, "mass_g": 430}
